name: atlas
description: Electron shell for Atlas — wires the Atlas backend to the v0 UI

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n RENDERER,BACKEND,ELECTRON -c blue,magenta,green "npm run dev:renderer" "npm run dev:backend" "wait-on http://localhost:3000 && wait-on http://localhost:7341/health && cross-env ATLAS_RENDERER_URL=http://localhost:3000 electron ."
scripts.postinstall: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix renderer install
